title: Robert Sarbacher and UFO secrecy through the Atomic Energy Act of 1954
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Robert Sarbacher and UFO secrecy through the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, about 1950s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: David Grush says went on to basically create UFO secrecy through the Atomic Energy Act of 1954 and was very close confidant with Thomas Townsen Brown

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, passes on a claim from David Grusch, a man who has come forward as a witness on UFO secrecy, about a scientist named Robert Sarbacher. According to Grusch, Sarbacher went on in the 1950s to more or less create UFO secrecy through the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, a US law about atomic energy and its secrets, and was a close friend of a man named Thomas Townsend Brown. If true, it would mean UFO secrets were hidden by the same law that guards nuclear secrets.
